Description: Attacks force sailings from India, Sri Lanka and Pakistan to the US East Coast round the Cape: +14 days and fewer slots.
A weak monsoon and heatwave cut chilli, pulse and cumin crops by about 40%.
Government curbs cut basmati shipments by half for four months.

Scenario Name: US East & Gulf Coast port strike
Description: Dockworkers strike for three weeks; containers on the Red Sea / Suez and Panama Canal routes wait offshore.

Scenario Name: Sri Lanka fuel and currency crisis
Description: Fuel shortages and power cuts halve factory output for two months.
A typhoon floods the southern provinces; seafood and jasmine processing stops for a month.
